front.title: Simple Two-Way Active Measurement Protocol (STAMP) Extensions for Signaling Parameters

abstract.t: The Simple Two-Way Active Measurement Protocol (STAMP) specified in RFC 8762 supports active measurement of network performance without a control channel to pre-signal session parameters. RFC 8972 defines optional extensions in the form of Type-Length-Value (TLV) elements for STAMP. This document defines a STAMP Type-Length-Value (TLV) that allows a Session-Sender and a Session-Reflector to exchange measurement capabilities and configuration parameters in STAMP-Test packets. The Session-Sender uses the returned parameters to configure a STAMP session.
